title: PGC Reference Implementation: Snapshot Inspector (snapshot_inspector)
description:
Read-only inspection over assembled PGC snapshots, providing the governed read surface used for grounding and status during transformation.

Part of the Protocol-Governed Computing reference corpus. Cite the version DOI of the release you used, not the concept DOI.
